description: This file provides utility functions for memory management, buffer handling, string parsing, and hashing within the reftable project, including custom allocators, buffer operations, and binary search.

methods.name: reftable_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with optional custom allocator, returns NULL if size is zero or allocation fails.

methods.name: reftable_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory with optional custom realloc, frees memory if size is zero.

methods.name: reftable_free
methods.description: Frees memory using custom free if set, otherwise uses standard free.

methods.name: reftable_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory for an array, returns NULL on overflow or failure.

methods.name: reftable_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string using custom allocator.

methods.name: reftable_set_alloc
methods.description: Sets custom memory allocation functions.

methods.name: reftable_buf_init
methods.description: Initializes a reftable buffer.

methods.name: reftable_buf_release
methods.description: Releases buffer memory and reinitializes buffer.

methods.name: reftable_buf_reset
methods.description: Resets buffer length and null-terminates buffer.

methods.name: reftable_buf_setlen
methods.description: Sets buffer length with boundary checks.

methods.name: reftable_buf_cmp
methods.description: Compares two buffers lexicographically.

methods.name: reftable_buf_add
methods.description: Appends data to buffer, growing buffer if needed.

methods.name: reftable_buf_addstr
methods.description: Appends a string to buffer.

methods.name: reftable_buf_detach
methods.description: Detaches buffer memory and reinitializes buffer.

methods.name: binsearch
methods.description: Performs binary search with a custom comparison function.

methods.name: free_names
methods.description: Frees an array of string pointers.

methods.name: names_length
methods.description: Calculates the length of a null-terminated array of strings.

methods.name: parse_names
methods.description: Parses newline-separated names from buffer into an array.

methods.name: names_equal
methods.description: Checks if two string arrays are equal.

methods.name: common_prefix_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of common prefix between two buffers.

methods.name: hash_size
methods.description: Returns hash size based on hash algorithm enum.
